## Section 1: Executive Summary & Overview
Financial institutions operating within international jurisdictions must establish automated compliance monitoring systems to detect, prevent, and report suspicious transactions under Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Counter-Terrorism Financing (CTF) directives. All automated systems must evaluate transaction velocities, beneficiary country risk scores, and entity sanction lists in real time prior to authorization.
